title: Jev reviewers for review hygiene: docs that went stale and PR review comments still open

AC1.note: review-jev-docs links doc sections deterministically (path/symbol/verb) and asks one Jev noul per selected section, bounded by --max-calls with truncation reported in selection.droppedSections. Fixed the live-check gap: linking/selection now ranks by evidence strength (path>symbol>verb, then distinct-link count) instead of alphabetical order, plus an 8-per-file cap. Live-verified on PRs #712/#717/#710 (real Jev calls via saved OpenRouter key, env -u OPENROUTER_API_KEY).

AC2.note: Findings carry reviewer:review-jev-docs, severity minor, file+heading+line, suggested_fix, evidence with Jev probability and (post-fix) matchCount/ranking basis. Deterministic flag-removal check (findDeterministicFlagFindings) runs with zero Jev calls, tested in jev-docs.test.ts and review-jev-docs-cli.test.ts.

AC3.note: review-jev-comments reads only the existing pr-comments ledger (readPrCommentState/unansweredComments), computes commitsTouching/resolvedThreadIds/replies as facts, and asks one Jev choice question per open comment among the 4 labels. Reviewed src/review/jev-comments.ts and src/commands/review-jev-comments.ts; no re-collection from GitHub.

AC4.note: still-open -> minor, needs-escalation -> major with required class_scope (single comment site); resolved-by-fix/not-actionable produce no finding. runCommentsReply (src/commands/review.ts ~L1425) prints the advisory label read-only via readCommentAdvisoryLabels and never touches pass/outcomes/posted -- confirmed purely additive by diff read.

AC5.note: Both jevDocsGateRefusal/jevCommentsGateRefusal check opt-in (readJevDocsEnabled/readJevCommentsEnabled, fail-closed) before credential check, before any doc/ledger read or network call -- verified by reading runJevDocs/runJevComments call order and the AC5 gating tests. Redaction only via redactSensitiveText re-exported from src/security/service.ts. GraphQL call (RESOLVED_THREADS_QUERY) is a query only, no mutation field; no GitHub write anywhere in either reviewer.

AC6.note: src/tui/jev-docs-command.ts and jev-comments equivalent (/staledocs, /opencomments) render English text; src/tui/jev-* and opentui-tests-no-skips.ts src/tui both pass (1284 tests, 0 fail, 0 skips) after Part B's changes (JevDocsComputedResult.selection gained maxPerFile/rankingBasis, TUI call site and its tests updated accordingly).

AC7.note: reviewers.ts's BundledReviewer.engine (read from SKILL.md metadata.engine, best-effort) is unchanged logic from flow 330/332's own versions of the same field (byte-diffed PR722/PR726 vs this branch: identical code, comment wording differs slightly across the three -- noted as a minor merge-friction finding, not a defect). review-orchestrator/SKILL.md + SKILL.detail.md (bundled+installed, identical) document Wave B dispatch/gate/merge for engine:jev reviewers. CLI test confirms keryx review reviewers --json lists review-jev-docs with engine: jev.

AC8.note: Pure-function tests (jev-docs.test.ts, jev-comments.test.ts) and CLI tests with fixture diffs/docs/comments + recorded Jev responses (review-jev-docs-cli.test.ts, review-jev-comments-cli.test.ts) validate findings against reviewer-finding.schema.json. All use mkdtemp(tmpdir()) -- hermetic, macOS-safe. Part B's new/changed assertions (7 of them: matchCount, rank-not-alphabetical, per-file cap, rankingBasis, corpus narrowing, --include) were revert-checked: reverted src/review/jev-docs.ts and src/commands/review-jev-docs.ts to the pre-fix committed baseline (git show HEAD:<file>), confirmed all 7 fail meaningfully, then restored the fix and confirmed all pass again.

AC9.note: Live check run (by the agent, per explicit operator instruction overriding the flow's own AC9 journal clause) on 3 merged PRs (#712, #717, #710), env -u OPENROUTER_API_KEY (saved openrouterKey from ~/.local/share/keryx/auth.json), from a clean gh-cloned scratch checkout, review.jev.docs:true. Before-fix (alphabetical, broad corpus) linked 2225/1847/2288 sections; after-fix (ranked, narrowed corpus) linked 1905/1497/1898. Real Jev calls: 6 total (well under ~60), cost ~/usr/bin/zsh.007 combined. Default-threshold (0.5) findings: 0/0/0 for all three PRs. A diagnostic --threshold 0 run surfaced the near-threshold candidates (10+5+5=20 items, probabilities 0.11-0.38) -- hand-labelled: none are false positives (all correctly scored below the real threshold by Jev); the dominant pattern is architecture/PRD/roadmap docs whose matchCount is inflated by generic backtick-quoted tokens shared with large frequently-touched files (src/cli.ts, src/commands/review.ts, src/commands/providers.ts) -- Jev's own judgement correctly suppressed all of them. Operator's own ~/notes/jev-in-keryx.md journal is intentionally NOT written by the agent per this AC's own text.

AC10.note: CI now 19/19 green on #727 (headRefOid 0ba24910); gh pr view 727 --json statusCheckRollup confirms all checks SUCCESS. Prior AC10 confirmation was pending only this CI-green condition; now satisfied.
